title: J. The Power of the Sun

legend: Dr. Otto Octavius is a brilliant nuclear physicist working on his life's work: a sustainable fusion power source. He claims to have "the power of the sun, in the palm of his hand" with his new Infinite Factorial Reactor.
The reactor consists of n%%ZSMJ0%% fusion cores lined up in a row, indexed from 1%%ZSMJ1%% to n%%ZSMJ2%%. Initially, the i%%ZSMJ3%%-th core holds an energy level of ai%%ZSMJ4%%.
Octavius uses his mechanical arms to conduct q%%ZSMJ5%% operations. In each operation, he interacts with a specific range of cores [l,r]%%ZSMJ6%%. The operations are of two types:

Fusion Ignition: Octavius triggers a reaction in the cores from index l%%ZSMJ7%% to r%%ZSMJ8%%. The energy level of every core in this range transforms into its own factorial. Formally, for each i%%ZSMJ9%% such that l≤i≤r%%ZSMJ10%%, the energy level ai%%ZSMJ11%% becomes ai!%%ZSMJ12%% (where 0!=1%%ZSMJ13%% and x!=1×2×⋯×x%%ZSMJ14%% for x≥1%%ZSMJ15%%).

Stability Check: Octavius measures the total energy output of the cores from index l%%ZSMJ16%% to r%%ZSMJ17%%. However, the inhibitor chip has a limit and can only display the result modulo 998244353%%ZSMJ18%%. Formally, the reading is (∑ri=lai)(mod998244353)%%ZSMJ19%%.
Help Dr. Octavius simulate the reactor's behavior and determine the energy readings for all type 2 operations.
input: The first line contains a single integer t%%ZSMJ20%% (1≤t≤105%%ZSMJ21%%) — the number of test cases.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n%%ZSMJ22%% and q%%ZSMJ23%% (1≤n,q≤5⋅105%%ZSMJ24%%) — the number of fusion cores and the number of operations.
The second line contains n%%ZSMJ25%% integers a1,a2,…,an%%ZSMJ26%% (0≤ai≤5⋅105%%ZSMJ27%%) — the initial energy levels of the cores.

Each of the next q%%ZSMJ28%% lines contains three integers type%%ZSMJ29%%, l%%ZSMJ30%%, r%%ZSMJ31%% (type∈{1,2}%%ZSMJ32%%, 1≤l≤r≤n%%ZSMJ33%%) — describing an operation of the corresponding type on the range [l,r]%%ZSMJ34%%.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n%%ZSMJ35%% over all test cases does not exceed 5⋅105%%ZSMJ36%% and the sum of q%%ZSMJ37%% over all test cases does not exceed 5⋅105%%ZSMJ38%%.
output: For each operation of type 2%%ZSMJ39%%, print a single integer — the sum of energy levels in the range modulo 998244353%%ZSMJ40%%.
